title: E0011: Error suppression operator `@`
plain_english: The `@` error control operator suppresses PHP errors and warnings. This rule flags its use.
why_matters: Suppressing errors hides underlying problems, such as failed file reads, undefined indexes, or connection errors. This makes failures harder to detect and debug, especially when issues only appear in production.
what_it_checks: Expressions and return statements that use the error control operator (`@`).
